title: Everyday Phrases — Ordering Delivery
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】🛵 實用點外送必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — Ordering Delivery
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用點外送情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從打開外送App搜店、選餐口味備註、付款下單，到追蹤騎士、門口收餐、缺餐補送與退款，全部用最基礎的A1簡單英文說出。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Ordering Delivery phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering the whole flow: searching restaurants in the app, choosing dishes, paying, tracking the rider, and fixing a missing-item order. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you feel like eating?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you need to log in?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type noodles in the search bar.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A few say it's too salty.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, that worries me a bit.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that too long for you?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I want to try that one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Six is fine for us two.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll tap the six piece box.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a hot chili noodle bowl.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: True, it won't fill us up.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So let's leave it out this time.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ lɛts liv ɪt aʊt ðɪs taɪm./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do they sell hot and sour soup?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðeɪ sɛl hɑt ænd ˈsaʊr sup?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have tea at home anyway.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 評論裡有顧客實拍照片。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That rice bowl looks so good.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One person says it came cold.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Close is good for warm food.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, less time on the road.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we see one more shop?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This second place has three stars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much worse than the first one.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're right, go back to it.
dialogue.zh: 你說得對，回頭選第一家。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Back to the new five star one.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk tə ðə nu faɪv stɑr wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 回到那家新晉五星的店。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Me too, let's start the order.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, does this shop do deals?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check for a first order gift.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 你看，這裡有一張優惠券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a minimum for it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What cheap thing can we add?
dialogue.zh: 我們能加個什麼便宜的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 麵加湯的組合比較便宜。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Swap our items for that combo.
dialogue.zh: 把我們點的換成那套餐。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll note it in special requests.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It tastes like soap to me.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得它吃起來像肥皂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if you ask for them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do the fries come in sizes?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we change one side dish?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Extra chili oil, is that okay?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Keep the sauce on the side.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 滿二十美元有送東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 太好了，記得跟他們要餅乾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 扣掉折抵，總價不到二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick now or a time slot.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We want it as soon as possible.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɑnt ɪt æz sun æz ˈpɑsəbəl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, ten, fifteen, or twenty percent.
dialogue.zh: 有，百分之十、十五或二十。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's good till next month, I think.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɡʊd tɪl nɛkst mʌnθ aɪ θɪŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我記得它下個月就到期。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你輸入，我在旁邊跟著核對。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, let me look once more.
dialogue.zh: 等等，讓我最後檢查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 當然，再把每樣東西檢查一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No peanut warning in the note?
dialogue.zh: 備註裡沒寫花生過敏嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh right, I'll add no peanuts.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 過敏這件事開不得玩笑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We did it, food is coming.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好，我會記得下次換你請。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Deal, I'll have my card out.
dialogue.zh: 說定，下次我會把卡備好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 收據的郵件記得傳給我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it is, I got the mail.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt ɪz aɪ ɡɑt ðə meɪl./

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 我記下來以備不時之需。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now we just wait and see.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do we track the rider?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 對，我們可以看他的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們的訂單狀態變了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it says heading to the store.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ɪt sɛz ˈhɛdɪŋ tə ðə stɔr./
dialogue.zh: 變了，顯示他正往店裡去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the wait so long?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 有人下了一張超大訂單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we write the gate code?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 好，那個柵門常讓人搞混。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's him, I see the name.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 嗨 Daniel，我們門牌是十二號。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'm at a blue house already.
dialogue.zh: 我已經到一間藍色的房子了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: No, twelve is the gray one.
dialogue.zh: 不對，十二號是灰色那間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There are two gray doors here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們家門口有紅色信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see it now, is that right?
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ɪt naʊ ɪz ðæt raɪt?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, park by the low fence.
dialogue.zh: 對，把車停在矮圍欄旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The fence is low, no problem.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The gate code is four one nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ɡeɪt koʊd ɪz fɔr wʌn naɪn./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Go to the front porch, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see the light, it's warm here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ðə laɪt ɪts wɔrm hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我看到燈了，這裡挺暖和。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, leave it at the door.
dialogue.zh: 等等，把餐放在門口就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我們正在看門鈴畫面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I can see it on my phone too.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ kæn siː ɪt ɑn maɪ foʊn tuː./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows he's at our gate.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz hiz æt ˈaʊər ɡeɪt./
dialogue.zh: App 顯示他到了我們柵門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He paused to check his phone.
dialogue.zh: 他停下來看了一下手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 可能在讀我們的柵門備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it start to rain outside?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, just light rain, don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 騎慢一點，我們不趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The map shows a red dot.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That's him, look at the screen.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The door camera just lit up.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see a yellow helmet there.
dialogue.zh: 我看到那裡有個黃色頭盔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那是我們的騎士，揮手問個好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He can't hear through the rain.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did he set the bag down?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the bag sealed with tape?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, off to the next stop.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他傳訊說，祝你們用餐愉快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did our tip get to him?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He should get more for this.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He handled the bags so well.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 什麼都沒被晃到或灑出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們看一下 App 的狀態。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 比上次點的那單好多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 除了那兩扇會混淆的灰門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We should fix our address note.
dialogue.zh: 我們該改一下地址備註。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 以後騎士就不用打電話了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 存好了，備註看起來清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 現在我們打開餐點來吃。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's set it on the table.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, where are the spring rolls?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And look, the fries are small.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we really didn't get them.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fries size is wrong too.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says large on this paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This is bad, to be honest.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那裡有個客服聊天按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, after a short bot note.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll type: no rolls, fries small.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ask for a quick fix, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不會，來的是另一位騎士。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tell him about the gray doors.
dialogue.zh: 提醒他灰色門的那件事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The saved note already says it.
dialogue.zh: 我們存的備註已經寫了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Daniel was really nice, wasn't he?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the store needs two stars.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 兩樣都寫進去了，別擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The store replied to my review.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, let's see if they do.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If not, we open a claim.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A claim? How does that work?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, I hope it's not needed.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the fresh ones will be hot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs ðə frɛʃ wʌnz wɪl bi hɑt./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 一樣的袋子，這次有貼封條。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it right by the camera.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the big fries too, finally.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check the soup, did it spill?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No leaks, the lid is taped.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a photo for the chat.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They thank us and close it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 他們還附上一張優惠券。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five dollars for the next order.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, but let's not test that.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 八點前就點，別拖到九點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And read the receipt at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd rid ðə rɪˈsit æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 餐送到時，當場對一遍收據。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, their noodles are worth it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Or try that four point seven place?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔr traɪ ðæt fɔr pɔɪnt ˈsɛvən pleɪs?/
dialogue.zh: 還是試試那家四點七分的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 你是說附近那家餃子店？
